decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that the proposed first floor extension, because of its position, design and appearance, would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of No.26 East Road, Bedfont and would not be detrimental to the amenity of the area or the adjoining and neighbouring properties. On balance, the development is in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 and H.6.4 of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003, and is generally compliant with the Residential Extension Guidelines. It is considered that where the development is not compliant there are no undue adverse effects resulting from this.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of first floor rear extension to dwellinghouse.
